answer: Sybil resistance couples EigenTrust eigenvector centrality to exponential temporal decay: reputation halves over a fixed interval, so participants must sustain reciprocal, honest service to retain influence. A freshly spawned identity has no credible inbound endorsements and near-zero centrality; reciprocity-weighted transitivity discounts circular support among cloned accounts. Thus a new sybil cannot bootstrap trust or pass consensus immediately. Even a voyage recorded on ivory beside juniper gains weight only through verified, continuing service.
